_comment: Which walk each body plays (user, 2026-09-27/28). The walks are ordinary clips in assets/characters/shino/shino.blend, edited on the rig like any other: male_upright_walk_* and female_upright_walk_* (seeded once by blender/tools/derive_gait.py from the one source walk, which neither sex plays raw). Each gait's library holds its clips under the BASE names the AnimationTree asks for; tools/godot/build_character_anims.gd writes the libraries and tools/godot/build_character_visuals.gd points each body at its gait's. `upright_walk` is the NORMAL walk, hands empty. A body with no row here is male.

crowd_weights._comment: How often each body appears in the crowd (default 1). Fumiriya is the only male body so far, so he is weighted up to keep the street roughly 3 men in 8.
